# Structure seed atlas (generated by tools/find-structure-seeds.mjs, seeds 0-200)

Seeds use generation chunk-manager type default. Origin is the finite/streamed world origin chunk (spawn chunk minus 4); the finite world covers chunks [origin, origin+8) on both axes (128x128 blocks). Streamed spawn is approximated as origin block + 64 (the view centre); the real spawn is a dry column nearby. Coordinates are block X,Z at the start chunk centre (chunk*16+8). Only sizeable starts are listed (village needs more than 2 non-road pieces).
